page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with left-margin year numbers beside the entries, small right-margin numbers, a label "An.M." at top left, the running head and page number at top right, and a catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: An.M.ditos. Quâ occasione decem tribus deficiunt, & fit schisma regni, Ieroboamo obtinente regnum Israël.1.Reg.14.

2970Ahia, Iddo, & Semeia, prophetæ, florent. 2. Chron.9.1.Reg.12.Floret etiam propheta ἀνώνυμος[?], qui contra altare Bethel clamat, & exprimit nomen eucrsoris Iosiæ, annis 350 antequam fieret. 1.Reg.13.v.32.
2986.Abia,rex Iuda, annos 2.regnat. 1.Reg.15.
2988.Asa[?] fit rex Iuda:item Nadab, rex Israël.1.Reg.15.10
2990.Baesa regnat in Israël. 2. Reg.16. Tempore Baesæ & Asæ florent Iehu, Hanani, & Asaria, prophetæ. 2.Paral.15.16.19.
3000.Medium mundi incidit in annum 13 Asæ.
3002.Asa ingenti prælio vincit regem Æthiopum15 Zaram. 2.Paral.14.& 15.
3014.Ela fit rex in Israël, an.2:& cum illo Zamri, dies 7. 1.Reg.16.
3014.Amri fit rex in Israël,an.12.e quibus duo includuntur annis Elæ. 1.Reg.16.10
3026.Achab regnat in Israël unà cum uxore suâ idololatricâ Iezebel. 1.Reg.16. Elias propheta hoc tempore claret. Eius discipulus fuit Elisæus. 1.Reg.17. 2.Reg.2.
3029.Iosaphath fit rex Iuda.1.Reg.22.15
3040.Micha, propheta sub Ahabo, floret. 2.Reg.22.
3045.Ochozias, seu Ahasia, regnat in Israël. 1.Reg.22.20
3048.Ioram succedit Ochoziæ. 2.Reg.3.
3054.Ioram, rex Iuda, succedit Iosaphatho.2.Reg.8.
3062.Ochozias, rex Iuda, succedit Ioramo. 1.Reg.22.30
3063.Athalia, fœmina, capessit regnum Iuda. 2.Reg. 11.
Eodem anno Iehu fit rex in Israël. 1.Reg.10.
3069Ioas fit rex in Iudâ.2.Reg.11.
3091.Ioachas regnat in Israël. 2. Reg.13. Ioiada facer-dos, optimè de regno Iudâ meritus, circa hæc25

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek word ἀνώνυμος and the name "Asa" (printed with a form that could also read Affa or Assa) are marked [?]. "eucrsoris" is copied as printed, with a likely printing error. The right-margin numbers 10, 10, 15, 20, 30 and 25 are placed at the nearest entry lines and their exact positions are uncertain. The line "2.Reg." / "11." is printed across two lines and joined. The catchword "tempora" stands below the last line at the right. The label "An.M." is a printed margin label at top left.
